description: This source file provides functions to retrieve system memory info and graphics display parameters such as GPU RAM size and display resolution, specifically for RPI (Raspberry Pi) devices using DRM/KMS interfaces.

methods.name: parseLine
methods.description: Parses a line of text to extract a numerical value.

methods.name: getMemInfo
methods.description: Reads /proc/meminfo to retrieve total or free memory information.

methods.name: getPrimaryPlane
methods.description: Retrieves the primary display plane information via DRM/KMS.

methods.name: getGraphicSize
methods.description: Obtains the width and height of the primary display using DRM/KMS.

methods.name: SoC_GetTotalGpuRam
methods.description: Returns total GPU RAM in bytes.

methods.name: SoC_GetFreeGpuRam
methods.description: Returns free GPU RAM in bytes.

methods.name: SoC_GetGraphicsWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of the display in pixels.

methods.name: SoC_GetGraphicsHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of the display in pixels.
